raw:
Agent Name: AlgorithmDesign_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: They built the pathfinding and color-reading logic on pandas-loaded cell values, which do not include Excel cell fill colors. This ignored the map’s color formatting (needed to avoid blue cells and to read the landing cell’s color) and led to checking for the string 'blue' instead of actual fill color, as well as attempting to convert text content to a hex code. The algorithm also did not enforce “no backward movement” or target the END cell explicitly, resulting in an incorrect conclusion that no color information was available.
